node.title: Actual pair ownership and geometric branch budget give a finite-domain energy bound
node.statement: For primitive polynomial operator3 pairs, the actual plane image has normalization degree nu=D/eta and finite fibre size at most nu times the geometric branch count. Planarity gives total binom(branches,2) at most binom(eta-1,2). Coupling this with actual disjoint-pair ownership and finite domain capacity bounds remaining core incidence by n/2+sqrt((n+2nu*g)(n/4+2nu*binom(M,2))). Singular fibres, ramification and original pair owners are retained.
